$comment: Discrete, volunteer-observed ICE Air flights through MSP airport.
THIS LAYER IS EYEWITNESS-SOURCED, NOT GOVERNMENT-CONFIRMED. No agency
publishes departure manifests or passenger counts for ICE Air charter
flights. What exists instead is Minnesota 50501's volunteer observation
effort at MSP -- covered independently by KSTP and NPR -- logging what
observers can see from outside the fence: which aircraft, roughly how many
people boarded, and where the flight was told or reported to be headed.
RULES
1. Every flight cites the source that reported it under `asserts`, keyed
the same way as data-center-projects.json. No unattributed field.
2. Passenger counts and destinations are reported, not verified against
any manifest. Say so; never round up to certainty.
3. Geometry is a single point at MSP -- the observation location -- never
a drawn route to the reported destination. We do not have a verified
flight path, only a claimed endpoint, and a line would assert precision
we don't have.
4. Refreshed by pull request as new flights are transcribed from the
source below, not by a scraper -- the source is a session-authenticated
Airtable share view with no stable public API to automate against.
5. `icao24` is the aircraft's transponder hex address (not asserted by the
source above -- looked up once per tail number against the FAA
Releasable Aircraft Registry, cited on the record itself). It's what
lets scripts/ingest/flights.mjs also track this specific aircraft live,
regardless of whether its current registered owner matches one of the
named ICE Air contractors.

mn50501-airtable.name: MN50501: MSP ICE Air Flights, compiled by Nick Benson
mn50501-airtable.compilerContact: nick@ottergoose.com — for corrections/verification reference only, not republished in the generated dataset
mn50501-airtable.license: "These data can be used by anyone; attribution 'Nick Benson, MN50501' is appreciated." (stated on the base itself, not a formal license)
mn50501-airtable.methodology: Best effort is made to keep the sheet updated within 24 hours of an ICE Air flight arriving/departing MSP. The compiler states the base is believed to include all ICE Air flights through MSP since 2025-10-01.

flights.icao24Source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Registry (MASTER.txt, MODE S CODE HEX field), looked up 2026-08-01

mn50501-airtable.note: Logged by volunteer observers at MSP.
